seedParams.entry: current oracle mark (seedAccounts opens at mark)

notes: Timings are keeper-side wall clock (Date.now()): submittedAt right before eth_sendRawTransaction, confirmedAt when the receipt poll first sees the receipt (includes up to receiptPollMs + RPC latency).
wallClockMs = first lane batch submitted → last lane batch receipt observed.
accountsScanned counts every account registered in the 8 lanes, including accounts seeded by earlier runs.
AUSD amounts are raw 6-decimal integers; gas values are integers as strings.
Local anvil with interval mining: block time and ordering are anvil's, NOT Monad's.
